product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do DRY-01376 Wood Clothespins with Spring, 3.3-inches Length,Brown, Medium, 100-Pack
features: Spring-loaded action secures clothes to the line, keeping them fluttering in the breeze
Holds up to 10 pounds each to handle heaviest sweaters and heftiest garments
Made from birch, a hardwood naturally resistant to moisture
Great for outdoor or indoor drying
Dimensions: 3.25'' L x 0.5'' W x 0.4'' H
description: These wooden clothespins are tried-and-true. Sure, until late into our 20s, we used them almost exclusively to fasten chip bags, but still—there was no denying the security of the spring-loaded grip. Now, as we hustle baskets of wet laundry outside to capture rays of sunshine and blasts of fresh air whenever possible, these classic wooden clothespins are kept close at hand. Naturally drying clothes saves on energy and can extend the wear-life of a wardrobe, especially for go-to pieces like daily denim, chic cardigans, and vintage band T-shirts. So stick with a classic. And with a pack of 100, you’ll probably have plenty to keep in the pantry for chip bags.
